review_scope: Frozen brief technical/visual/factual/specification/runtime review; user selection remains separate. No asset edits.

criteria.evidence: Exact GLB independently hashed and JSON chunk inspected. Khronos report has zero errors/warnings. Source-export report binds matching source/GLB and reports identical evaluated triangles and bounds. Rebuild has byte-identical GLB and semantic digest. 122504 bytes, 6124 mesh triangles, 3360 exported POSITION vertices, 4 materials, 5 primitives, 0 textures meet budgets. Smooth shading is intentional and visually stable; below-origin fringe agrees with free-swimming mount. Authored/evaluated source part vertex sum is 3264 in source audit; exported POSITION count is separate.

All eight source and ten exact-GLB browser views opened. Tall softly angular bell, open lower margin, attached short fringe, and slight swimming tilt remain legible. No conspicuous detached major part, penetration, cracked shading or accidental spike seen. At 80 px fringe becomes a narrow texture-like edge; at 160–240 px it reads as a short fringe. Recognizable minimum gate passes; lamp/shade association remains an art advisory, and user acceptance is pending.

Soft rounded-square plan remains visible in source top and browser bottom. Bell is tall and mostly upright despite slight artistic tilt; bottom view and generator ring construction show hollow bell and open lower margin rather than a lower cap. Meets basic-form inspired-art scope, not exact fossil morphology certification. BURG-ROM body paragraphs support bell-bodied medusa; cuboidal specificity is the artistic/inventory obligation.

Browser bottom/side and source clay show dense attached marginal fringe of short tapering tentacles. No few giant arms. Generator uses 96 tentacles as artistic simplification, not fossil count. BURG-ROM body paragraphs establish tentacles, not this count or precise arrangement.

Pale seafoam mildly transmitting shell retains bell/fringe silhouette in browser views. Exact GLB includes KHR_materials_transmission factor .38 and KHR_materials_ior 1.34 on both shell materials, roughness .30. Four inner folds are visible through it at 240–480 px. Label explicitly says static inspired art, not scientific reconstruction or living modern box-jelly species.

Editable source, standalone GLB, generator/config, eight source previews and exact-browser evidence present. Static stylized label is explicit. Final versioned freeze.json independently checked: all seven artifact records match actual SHA-256 and byte size, including source, final shared generator, config, brief, references, GLB and helper. Final-validation-r2 reproducibility binds this final generator to byte-identical reviewed GLB.
Three.js 180 browser report binds exact reviewed GLB; matching bounds, 4 materials, 5 primitives, no textures, errors=[] and failed=[]. GLB extensions independently inspected.

All exact-export browser images opened. WebGL2 ANGLE Vulkan SwiftShader Device(Subzero), Google, renders transmission without disappearance or obvious broken shading. Functional software render evidence only; physical GPU/device performance unverified.

Scene hero/top opened: three Burgessomedusa copies among nine visible props. Single-asset browser has 8 calls / 10812 submitted triangles; these transmission-inclusive render counts are not the 6124 unique asset triangles. No timing or museum integration claim.

advisories.observation: The smooth tall dome, regular pale rim and repeated comb-like fringe still read as a shade or tasselled cover. Transmission exposes four long internal ribs, which can strengthen that association. The tilt reduces rigid vertical presentation but does not fully resolve this visual ambiguity.
advisories.action: Present candidly for user selection; no further cosmetic changes authorized/requested in this bounded review.

advisories.observation: Blender source renders look substantially more opaque and grainier than browser transmission views. Browser is the material verdict; source previews alone would understate visible folds and glass-like response.
advisories.action: Use exact-browser preview when asking user to judge revised appearance.

advisories.observation: At 80 px individual fingers and internal structure mostly disappear. Bell plus narrow fringe remains; species-level recognition at that scale is not established.
advisories.action: Keep stated 80–240 px prop scope and avoid distant species-identification claims.

advisories.observation: ROM release independently read (2023-08-02, bell/tentacle body paragraphs). Exact fossil dimensions, number of tentacles, four folds, transparency, color and swimming pose are not independently certified. Primary paper not full-text reviewed.
advisories.action: Retain stylized-inspired claim and artistic simplification labels.

comparison.matching_limits: Shared named views and browser lighting profile; geometry/pose changed, so this is a whole-revision comparison, not a controlled material A/B.
comparison.observed_improvement: Broad alternating lavender facets and rigid upright presentation in v001 become a quieter seafoam shell with soft transitions, rounded apex/shoulders, slightly contracted lower margin and gentle tilt. Source clay confirms smooth transition improvement comes from shape/shading, not color alone. Short fringe hierarchy retained.
comparison.remaining_limit: The main mass is still a tall regular dome with a uniform skirt. More natural/refined is directionally improved, but beauty or satisfaction is not established by these gates.
